data.description: When a clay golem enters combat, there is a cumulative 1%% chance each round that its elemental spirit breaks free and the golem goes berserk. This chance resets to 0%% after one minute of inactivity. A berserk golem attacks the nearest living creature or smashes some object smaller than itself if no creature is within reach. Once it goes berserk, no known method can reestablish control.
data.name: Berserk
